posts.concept: Ordering by phone calls and paper lists costs procurement staff hours every week that digital ordering does not.
posts.angle: Frame the switching cost as small compared to what manual ordering already costs the buyer in time.
posts.rationale: Opens the week with a soft install push tied to a pain point, not a hard sell.

posts.concept: Real-time delivery tracking lets procurement staff see order status without calling the supplier.
posts.angle: Single-feature explainer on tracking, framed around not needing to chase a phone call for status.
posts.rationale: First hard install push of the week, on a concrete feature.

posts.concept: Every session expires automatically after 30 days, so a lost or shared device does not leave an account exposed indefinitely.
posts.approved_fact: Security: HTTPS encryption, one-time OTP login, 30-day session expiry, continuous error monitoring
posts.angle: Session-expiry angle — distinct from the OTP/data-not-sold angle already used in a prior week.
posts.rationale: Credibility post; no CTA per cadence rule for this pillar.

posts.concept: A 3-step walkthrough of placing a first order: search, add to cart, confirm.
posts.angle: How-to walkthrough rather than a single-feature explainer, to vary the pillar's shape from Monday.
posts.rationale: Second install push, using the app-screenshot template for a concrete step-by-step.

posts.concept: Buyers can reach support on WhatsApp and expect a reply within minutes, not a ticket queue.
posts.angle: Service promise framed as a question prompt to invite the reader to message in.
posts.rationale: Closes the week with the click-to-WhatsApp CTA per cadence.
